newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firm as yen eases vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firm as yen eases vs dlr.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer on Friday, lifted by technically-driven buying, supported by the yen's slight weakening against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen to 1.9 yen per kg higher. Benchmark July was up 1.7 yen at 145.4 yen.

Activity was lacklustre. The market started the day mostly firmer, following modest price gains on Thursday. "The market remained within recent narrow ranges. Weaker overseas markets, amid the oversupply trend, may put a lid on further gains," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
